text: 1. High School Graduate : Senior High School Diploma 2. Age between 18 and 50 3. Good command of English: Non-native English speakers usually need to score the IELTS tests at least 5.0 (or TOFEL 61) or equivalent. Applications may choose to take the DUFE English Exam as an alternative to the IELTS test. Native English speakers are generally exempt from the English language requirements and only need to meet the Academic Requirements described in section A
